acceptance: All three targets must improve validation RMSE >=1% against both respective baselines; otherwise record negative result with no six-factor promotion.
Final criteria identical per target, with bootstrap upper candidate-minus-baseline RMSE bound <0 and no >=30-game supported slice regression >5%.
Report correlations and training-half sign stability of supported coefficients; in-sample R-squared is not forecast accuracy.
artifacts: binding.json with release/dataset/source/transform versions, facts and exact game/row membership hashes
exclusions.json including every rejected game and reason
attempts.json with every config, seed, rows/dimensions, peak RSS, wall time and stop reason
baseline-predictions.jsonl and candidate-predictions.jsonl with role and immutable target keys
model artifact, dependency versions and reproduction command
baseline_recipes: Three training pooled league rates plus home adjustment.
Three training team/context ridge alpha=100 rate models.
calibration_recipe: None; disclose raw unbounded ridge rates and count out-of-[0,1] predictions, no post-hoc clipping.
candidate_recipes: Three weighted ridge models sharing alpha=10.
Three weighted ridge models sharing alpha=100.
Three weighted ridge models sharing alpha=1000.
estimand: Three held-out stint rate reconstructions with separate offensive/defensive player coefficients: conventional true shooting, turnover opportunity share, offensive rebound opportunity share.
exclusions: Exclude scheduled/nonfinal games, mixed phases, duplicate identity/event grains, quarantined games and incompatible source policies.
Exclude rows with unknown required target/exposure fields; absent rows are never zero.
Finalize complete game membership before splitting; never split one game across roles.
feature_recipe: Same sparse offensive/defensive indicator, intercept/home design and centering as courtload-rapm-v1; fit three independent weighted ridge models. One shared alpha selected by mean relative validation RMSE across three targets, no hidden per-target grid.
input_gates: RAPM lineup/reconciliation gates and three complete seasons.
New jointly valid event-to-stint opportunity counts must reconcile to final team boxes, including technical FT and team-rebound policies. Current B20 stint points/exposure alone are insufficient.
input_grains: event-attributed FGA, FGM, points, FTA, TOV, OREB and opponent DREB
limitations: Historical reconstruction does not establish publication-time availability.
Registered design is not a trained model or a cleared source gate.
Latest seasons previously inspected cannot be advertised as unexposed final tests.
preprocessing_recipe: Fit vocabularies, centering, scaling and reference rates on training only. Unknown validation/final players get zero coefficient plus unsupported flag; no future identity or full-season prior enters an earlier prediction.
sample_policy: Coefficient display requires >=1000 jointly valid target opportunities and >=20 games on each side; target-specific support. Held-out rows with missing components excluded from only that target and counted.
selection_metric: Mean target-wise validation RMSE divided by same-target league-baseline RMSE; zero baseline error blocks selection.
serving_policy: B26 artifacts are retrospective research only until separately promoted. Show fit/input/calibration horizons; forbid earlier-cutoff decoration by later-fit artifacts. No active points policy, forecast issuance or publication pointer changes.
target_recipe: Three separate targets/weights: shooting PTS/[2*(FGA+0.44*FTA)] weighted by 2*(FGA+0.44*FTA); turnover TOV/(FGA+0.44*FTA+TOV) weighted by that denominator; rebounding OREB/(OREB+opponent DREB) weighted by that denominator. Conventional coefficients are approximations, not exact true possessions. Require all numerator/denominator components valid and denominator>0 for each target independently.
tie_break: Prefer baseline on equality; otherwise candidate order as listed. No final-test selection.
uncertainty_recipe: Seed 2501; 200 game-cluster bootstrap resamples of held-out errors with frozen predictions, percentile 2.5/97.5 differences. For coefficients report sign/rank variation across chronological training halves; no causal confidence interval.
units: rate units; six coefficients are separate components, never an additive overall impact score
